description: All TIGER Grants 2016 is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by USDOT. This data set comprises all TIGER grants rounds up to 2016. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 16 columns, among them Location Precision, US States, Applicant, Round, Location 1 (address), Amount . The portal shows 2017-04-28 as the last data update. Attribution given: USDOT. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
